text:
Elena V.: Quick sync on the Crestline case study and launch. Interview happened this morning — need quick approvals and any embargo notes before we draft social.

Elena V.: Draft quote: "Crestline reduced inference costs by approximately 35% and observed a 20% reduction in 95th-percentile latency during steady-state runs in May 2025." Thoughts?

Jordan K.: Sounds good. Minor tone change: use "reduced" not "cut" (soft). Add a one-line pull quote for the hero image.

Luis M.: Legal: we need a signed media release that explicitly excludes paid ads (Crestline request). Also ask analytics for the raw export supporting the 35% number so legal can reference it in the attribution.

Rhea P.: For inbound routing, recommend HubSpot campaign tag crestline-launch-q2. Do we assign a named AE initially or round-robin?

Jordan K.: Assign to Maia K. for first touch, then round-robin afterwards. I'll update mapping once campaign exists.

Elena V.: Can Crestline provide a sanitized screenshot for the blog? They said yes if we redact hostnames. Luis, ok from legal?

Luis M.: Fine with sanitized screenshot but require written confirmation of redactions. Also remove absolute language like "always" or "guarantee" from any copy. Add attribution: "based on internal benchmarking provided by Crestline and Redwood (May 2025)."

Rhea P.: I'll spin up the HubSpot campaign and landing draft. Need final headline + CTA by Thursday COB. Landing -> registration -> campaign crestline-launch-q2 -> AE Maia K assigned.

ops-bot: Reminder: publish will fail without signed media release attached.

Elena V.: Checklist (react when done):
- [ ] Signed media release in Drive
- [ ] Benchmark export uploaded and linked
- [ ] Final quote approved by product + legal
- [ ] Landing page copy + CTA approved
- [ ] Slides + bios submitted
- [ ] HubSpot campaign + AE mapping live

Jordan K.: I'll draft social variants (product angle, cost angle, webinar invite) and avoid Crestline logo for paid channels per their restriction.

Luis M.: I'll follow up with Crestline legal for the signed release and confirm precise paid-ad exclusions.

Elena V.: Thanks team — target GO LIVE next Friday. I'll update when legal signs off. :rocket:
